mapper.select: SELECT answer FROM routine_answers WHERE routine_id = #{routineId}
SELECT description FROM routines WHERE routine_id = #{routineId}
SELECT score FROM routines WHERE routine_id = #{routineId}
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM routine_results WHERE routine_id = #{routineId} AND enrollment_id = #{enrollmentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO routine_results ( enrollment_id, routine_id, status, awared_score, pass_fail_result, answer_text, evidence_url, submitted_at ) VALUES ( #{enrollmentId}, #{routineId}, CASE WHEN #{passFailResult} = 'PASS' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END, #{awaredScore}, #{passFailResult}, #{answerText}, #{evidenceUrl}, #{submittedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE routine_results SET status = CASE WHEN #{passFailResult} = 'PASS' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END, awared_score = #{awaredScore}, pass_fail_result = #{passFailResult}, answer_text = #{answerText}, evidence_url = #{evidenceUrl}, submitted_at = #{submittedAt} WHERE routine_id = #{routineId} AND enrollment_id = #{enrollmentId}

UPDATE enrollments e_outer JOIN ( SELECT e_inner.enrollment_id, ROUND(COUNT(*) / MAX(total.total) * 100, 1) AS new_progress FROM routine_results rr JOIN routines r ON rr.routine_id = r.routine_id JOIN trainings t ON r.training_id = t.training_id JOIN enrollments e_inner ON rr.enrollment_id = e_inner.enrollment_id JOIN ( SELECT e2.enrollment_id, COUNT(*) AS total FROM routines r2 JOIN enrollments e2 ON r2.training_id = e2.training_id WHERE e2.enrollment_id = #{enrollmentId} GROUP BY e2.enrollment_id ) total ON e_inner.enrollment_id = total.enrollment_id WHERE rr.enrollment_id = #{enrollmentId} AND rr.pass_fail_result = 'PASS' GROUP BY e_inner.enrollment_id ) progress_result ON e_outer.enrollment_id = progress_result.enrollment_id SET e_outer.progress = progress_result.new_progress
